reason: E1 shows that cold rolling pre-strain increases dislocation density and yield strength in AlCoCrFeNi2.1, supporting premises 1 and 2. E2 demonstrates that an ultrafine lamellar duplex microstructure can enhance strength-ductility synergy, supporting premise 3. However, the specific claim that annealing after pre-strain will stabilize the microstructure and retain dislocations (premise 5) is not directly supported by the cited evidence, which only covers as-cast and pre-strained states without annealing.
